releases.name: b12653: ggml : update cmake MATH_LIBRARY check (#32864)
releases.body:
This commit updates the cmake check for MATH_LIBRARY and removes the
DEFINED operator for the if() command.
The motivation for this is that on windows if a parent project of ggml
calls find_library(MATH_LIBRARY) this could return
MATH_LIBRARY-NOTFOUND which will cause the if clause to be true.
Removing the DEFINED operator will work as intended will evaluate to
false, as specified by cmake if command docs:
False if the constant is 0, OFF, NO, FALSE, N, IGNORE, NOTFOUND, the
empty string, or ends in the suffix -NOTFOUND.
This commit was originally opened in a PR against whisper.cpp, see link
below.
Refs: ggml-org/whisper.cpp#4168
Refs: https://cmake.org/cmake/help/latest/command/if.html#constant

releases.body:
Release v5.24.0
New Model additions
Inkling 2 Mini
Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs. It is a smaller sibling of Inkling 2 Small, added in v5.23.0. It has 24 decoder layers instead of 48, and compensates with a looping mechanism in which layers 6 to 17 run three times. A learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and mixture-of-experts inputs of each loop layer. The decoder has a hidden size of 2304 and routes each token to 8 of 128 experts. The image encoder, tokenizer and processor are the same as Inkling 2 Small's.
